topic: An artist discovers someone has tattooed their work
text: Walking through the bustling market, my eyes caught a glimpse of something familiar, something deeply personal. There, on the upper arm of a young woman, was a design I knew too well—the delicate lines and intricate patterns that I had poured countless hours into, a piece that was as much a part of me as my own hands. The world seemed to hold its breath for a moment as I studied the way the tattoo moved with her, how the light played across the ink. It was my creation, yet transformed, a part of her story now. I found myself drawn closer, not just to admire, but to understand how my art had taken on a life of its own.
